newsitem.title: GERMANY: Holzmann - unaware of Hochtief plans.
newsitem.headline: Holzmann - unaware of Hochtief plans.

text.p: German construction group Philipp Holzmann AG said on Monday it had no knowledge of reported plans by fellow builder Hochtief AG to "pool" its stake in Holzmann with that of Deutsche Bank AG.
"Holzmann is not aware of any such plans," a Holzmann spokesman said in response to enquiries.

Hochtief had earlier denied a magazine report it planned to pool its 20 percent stake with a shareholding owned by Deutsche Bank in a bid to increase its control over Holzmann AG. Deutsche Bank has a stake of some 25.8 percent in Holzmann.
Hochtief's earlier efforts to increase its stake in Holzmann to 35 percent have been thwarted by German cartel authorities.
The authorities are due to begin hearings into plans by Hochtief and Holzmann to colloborate more closely, particularly on international projects, in early April.
